status: frozen before pairwise-win or AGL-separation null outputs were opened
trigger: The manuscript already emphasizes that finite-sample prediction-pipeline null expectations need not be zero. Two biological effect translations remained referenced to intuitive 0/0.5 baselines without their own session-label exchangeability nulls.

pairwise_self_win_null.statistic: equal-individual mean pairwise self-win fraction; alternatives averaged within target session, sessions equally within individual, individuals equally within panel
pairwise_self_win_null.candidate_profiles: same common-cell weighting and candidate self/alternative profile construction as biological_effect_translation_v1
pairwise_self_win_null.null: apply the exact existing panel whole-session label-permutation algorithm and seed to the fixed session blocks, then recompute the entire pairwise self-win pipeline under the permuted labels
pairwise_self_win_null.interpretation: The panel-specific null mean replaces 0.5 as the inferential reference. 0.5 may remain only as an intuitive visual reference.

manuscript_rule.calibrated_excess_positive_and_p_le_0_05: May describe the pairwise rate as a calibrated biological translation of the already-supported identity signal.
manuscript_rule.otherwise: Do not use that panel's pairwise rate as independent evidence; report it descriptively with its null baseline or move it to Supporting Information.

tadarida_agl_absolute_separation_null.statistic: equal-individual mean across sessions of |self_expected_AGL - other_expected_AGL| under common self-session horizontal weights
tadarida_agl_absolute_separation_null.permutation_null: reuse the exact Tadarida AGL whole-session label-permutation design from test_A_agl_common_cell, including B=9999, seed=2026092901, fixed session blocks and label-slot multiset; recompute the full absolute-separation statistic under each permuted label assignment

manuscript_rule.calibrated_excess_positive_and_p_le_0_05: May retain metre-scale separation in the main text, but report the null mean/calibrated excess alongside the raw 256 m.
manuscript_rule.otherwise: Remove 256 m as headline biological magnitude from abstract/main synthesis; retain only as a raw descriptive value with its non-zero null in Supporting Information.

tadarida_agl_absolute_separation_null.prohibited_switch: Do not switch after output to target-error distance or another separation statistic.

figure_rule.pairwise_baseline: plot panel-specific permutation-null means as the inferential baseline; 0.5 may be retained as a lighter intuitive reference only
figure_rule.separation: if retained in main text, annotate raw, null mean, and calibrated excess rather than raw 256 m alone

stop_rule: Do not change the observed effect definitions, session blocks, common-cell weights, candidate-profile construction, permutation unit, permutation seeds, or B after any null output is opened.
Do not treat this family as an independent confirmatory replication of the primary common-cell identity test.
Retain null means even if they make the biological effect look smaller.
Do not choose between absolute-separation calibration and target-error calibration after seeing results.
